name: Edge Extension Inventory Collector
description: Edge Extension Inventory Collector is a lightweight tool that scans endpoints to enumerate installed Microsoft Edge extensions, capturing extension ID, name, publisher, version, enabled state, and install source. It exports a consolidated inventory to JSON or CSV for software asset management, security audits, and Intune/Endpoint Manager workflows. It helps maintain visibility of browser extensions across managed devices and supports baseline compliance checks.
author: Maurice Flöthmann

securityCheck.aiSummary: No evidence of remote code execution or credential theft in the provided code. The primary concerns are hardcoded client secrets in the ClientSecretAuth script and the broad collection/transmission of tenant data (service principals and sign-ins) for reporting. Mitigate with secret management, least privilege, secure data handling, and consideration of using stable Graph APIs over Beta where feasible.
